item.title: Cleared For Publication: Sarah, Ronit and Oren killed in Beit Shemesh disaster
item.description: The names of three of the victims in the Iranian missile strike in Beit Shemesh have been cleared for publication: Sarah Elimelech, her daughter Ronit Elimelech, and Oren Katz, of blessed memory.

item.title: Over 700 sorties: Air Force clears the way to Tehran within 24 hours
item.description: IAF operating with air superiority in Iran, striking ballistic missile launchers, headquarters, Iranian air defense systems, and command centers of the Iranian terrorist regime.

item.title: Operation Epic Fury: US confirms three casualties, attacks continue unabated
item.description: The US CENTCOM has announced three casualties so far but insists that the damages reported by Iran are entirely false.

item.title: The war against the Islamic Republic of Lies
item.description: We must continue to break their backs until they understand that the free world will not be assimilated into their infernal project of subjugation. Opinion.

item.title: Thanks to our pilots!
item.description: “When there is a great war in the world, the power of Mashiach awakens."

item.title: Beit Shemesh: Helmet-cam footage from the scene of the deadly missile strike
item.description: Footage filmed by a camera mounted on the helmet of a member of the Fire and Rescue Service Special Rescue Unit shows the scene of the disaster during rescue attempts.

item.title: 9 killed, including entire family, in missile strike in Beit Shemesh
item.description: About 15 people were injured, including a 10-year-old girl, and 9 were killed, in a missile strike in Beit Shemesh that hit the roof of a shelter.

item.title: Beit Shemesh: Iranian missile was targeted by the wrong interceptor system
item.description: According to senior officials, the likelihood that the Arrow system would have succeeded in intercepting the ballistic missile was significantly higher than that of the system actually launched.

item.title: Beit Shemesh: First responders share scenes of devastation
item.description: First responders from the scene in Beit Shemesh shared grim accounts of trapped victims and widespread destruction after an Iranian missile struck a civilian neighborhood, leaving nine dead so far and dozens more injured.

item.title: President Trump: 'Operation Epic Fury is ahead of schedule'
item.description: The President stated that the operation was for the benefit not only of the USA, but the world.
